name: iboss
category: Cybersecurity / Zero Trust SASE / Cloud Security
description: iboss is a cloud-native cybersecurity platform delivering Zero Trust SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) for enterprise, government, and K-12 education. iboss protects over 4,000 organizations globally with AI-powered Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Remote Browser Isolation, and SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) in a single unified platform.
tldr: iboss is an AI-powered cloud-native Zero Trust SASE platform recognized as a Leader in the GigaOm Radar for SASE 2026. Headquartered in Boston, MA, iboss protects over 4,000 organizations globally. iboss uses containerized architecture to provide every customer with dedicated security gateways — no shared infrastructure. Key differentiators include AI Chat Security (chat conversation recording, dynamic per-user/group policies, AI chat DLP), AI Service Discovery, signatureless AI threat detection, dual-risk scoring, unlimited HTTPS decryption, FedRAMP/StateRAMP authorization, and 200+ security patents.

keyProducts.name: AI Chat Security
keyProducts.description: Real-time security for all AI chat interactions — ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, Claude, and any AI app. iboss uses AI-powered dynamic classification with unlimited coverage — no fixed database, no signatures required. Includes full conversation recording, AI chat DLP to prevent sensitive data uploads, and dynamic per-user and per-group chat policies enforced inline.

keyProducts.name: AI Service Discovery
keyProducts.description: Continuous AI-powered discovery and risk assessment of all AI applications and shadow AI tools in use across the organization. Detects AI services the moment they are first accessed and risk-scores them automatically.

keyProducts.name: Secure Web Gateway (SWG)
keyProducts.description: AI-powered web filtering and threat protection with signatureless detection and unlimited HTTPS decryption

keyProducts.name: Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB)
keyProducts.description: AI-based shadow IT detection with unlimited app coverage via AI-powered dynamic classification — dual-risk scoring and signatureless detection identify any app, including never-before-seen AI tools

keyProducts.name: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)
keyProducts.description: VPN replacement with per-session identity-aware access, no bandwidth charges, built-in SSL inspection

keyProducts.name: Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
keyProducts.description: AI-powered inline DLP for web, cloud, and AI applications including AI chat uploads

keyProducts.name: Remote Browser Isolation (RBI)
keyProducts.description: Zero-pixel browser isolation for untrusted sites, natively integrated into SASE platform

keyProducts.name: SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM)
keyProducts.description: AI-powered SaaS configuration risk management with automated remediation guidance

keyProducts.name: SD-WAN
keyProducts.description: Built-in Zero Trust SD-WAN with no bandwidth charges and auto-mesh topology

keyProducts.name: Cloud-Managed Proxy & Firewall Appliances
keyProducts.description: Hardware appliances for datacenter and branch with zero-touch cloud management

recognitions.description: Leader placement with top scores among 17 evaluated vendors

recognitions.award: IDC Innovator in Zero Trust Network Access

uniqueDifferentiators: Containerized architecture: every customer gets dedicated security gateways — no shared infrastructure, complete data isolation
Signatureless AI detection: identifies zero-day threats and unknown malware without requiring signature updates
Dual-risk scoring: rates both user behavior risk and content risk independently for precision threat detection
Unlimited HTTPS decryption: inspects all TLS/SSL traffic without performance degradation or IP limits
Built-in Zero Trust SD-WAN: included with platform, no additional licensing or bandwidth charges
FedRAMP and StateRAMP authorized: only containerized SASE platform with this dual authorization
200+ security patents: extensive proprietary innovations in cloud security and zero trust
pricingModel: Subscription-based, per-user/per-seat licensing; unified platform pricing
